title: 第5章 人皇幡第6章 重生者
slug: 我气运之子反派系统什么鬼
content_zh:
历飞雨？！
好家伙，这小丫头还真是谨慎。
墨羽心中暗笑，脸上却不动声色。
“我见你天资聪颖，根骨极佳，便想确认一下。”
楚玉璃内心一阵无语。
她一个五灵根的废柴。
有个屁的天赋。
还好，她这种废物当炉鼎都够呛。
不等她多想，墨羽已握住她纤细的手腕。
“不错，混沌灵根。”
片刻后，墨羽松开手，满意地点了点头。
天赋什么的不重要，对气运之子来说，都一样。
反正天道会追着你喂饭。
楚玉璃黛眉微蹙，声音略带苦涩。
“前辈，小女乃是五灵根。”
墨羽解释。
“单灵根为天灵根，双灵根为真灵根，三灵根乃杂灵根，四灵根是伪灵根，五灵根是废灵根，你可知？”
楚玉璃轻轻点头。
“五灵根，是废灵根，毫无价值。”
她连做炉鼎都不够格。

墨羽嘴角微扬。
“五灵根逆袭就是混沌灵根。”
“我认为你有那个能力。”
楚玉璃心头一紧。
不会真要抓自己去当炉鼎吧？
表面上说要帮她逆袭，实际上是馋她身子。
“多谢前辈厚爱。”
她强压心中惶恐，面上恭敬依旧。
心中却盘算着，怎么才能逃跑。
墨羽负手而立，衣袂飘飘，宛如谪仙降世。
“我见你有大毅力，未来无可限量。”
“金鳞岂是池中物，一遇风云便化龙。”
“有没有兴趣做我的弟子。”
他心中已经有了想法。
先把气运之女留在身边。
以后再研究怎么打压。
楚玉璃心中警铃大作，面上却愈发恭敬，甚至带上了一丝狂喜。
“愿意！弟子定不负师尊厚望！”
content_en:
Li Feiyu? !
Good guy, this little girl is really cautious.
Mo Yu secretly smiled in his heart, but his face remained calm.
"I saw that you are very talented and have excellent bones, so I wanted to confirm it."
Chu Yuli was speechless for a while.
She is a useless person with five spiritual roots.
He has a fart talent.
Fortunately, a piece of trash like her is enough to be used as a furnace.
Before she could think about it, Mo Yu had already held her slender wrist.
"Yes, Chaos Spirit Root."
After a moment, Mo Yu let go of his hand and nodded with satisfaction.
Talent or anything else doesn't matter, it's all the same to a child of luck.
Anyway, God will chase you to feed you.
Chu Yuli frowned slightly, her voice slightly bitter.
"Senior, my little girl has five spiritual roots."
Mo Yu explained.
"Single spiritual roots are heavenly spiritual roots, double spiritual roots are true spiritual roots, three spiritual roots are miscellaneous spiritual roots, four spiritual roots are false spiritual roots, and five spiritual roots are waste spiritual roots. Do you know?"
Chu Yuli nodded slightly.
"The five spiritual roots are waste spiritual roots and are worthless."
She is not even qualified to make a furnace.
The corners of Mo Yu's mouth raised slightly.
"The counterattack of the Five Spiritual Roots is the Chaos Spiritual Root."
"I think you have what it takes."
Chu Yuli's heart tightened.
You don’t really want to catch yourself as a cauldron, do you?
On the surface, he said he wanted to help her counterattack, but in fact, he was greedy for her body.
"Thank you for your love, senior."
She suppressed the fear in her heart, but her face remained respectful.
But in his heart, he was thinking about how to escape.
Mo Yu stood with his hands behind his back, his clothes fluttering, like an immortal descending into the world.
"I see you have great perseverance and your future is limitless."
"Golden scales are just a thing in the pond. They turn into dragons when encountering wind and clouds."
"Are you interested in becoming my disciple?"
He already had an idea in mind.
Keep the girl of luck with you first.
We will study how to suppress it later.
Chu Yuli's heart was ringing with alarm, but her face became more respectful, even with a hint of ecstasy.
"Yes! Disciple will definitely live up to Master's high expectations!"
